- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Overlay Visibility Test Stage: Redesign the home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring a live desktop pet spawn test action. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet failing to appear on desktop or app not opening, while finish step conversion is only 73.5%.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Risk Guard Notice on Sign-In: Add an account security hint on sign-in clarifying that logging into an existing account syncs and preserves current pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Selector Transition: Redesign choose_path into a story_scroll layout for visual comparison between fast adoption and custom generation. (why: choose_path conversion is 80.7% with a mean time of 514s, showing initial drop-off and friction right at the start.)
3: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Pet Render Activity Log: Add real-time render activity checklist items to the waiting screen while background assets compile. (why: The waiting step has a very long mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off before reaching the home screen.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Early Intro Story Companion Teaser: Update story intro text to clarify pet desktop overlay behavior upfront before path selection. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 34.6%; setting expectations early reduces drop-offs across the funnel.)
